ski.name: THE BOWL
ski.hello: THE BOWL. NOBODY HAS SKIED IT IN YEARS.

interactions.label: CARVED STONE
interactions.dialog:
A STANDING STONE, ITS FACE CUT WITH A LANTERN AND A LINE OF WORDS GONE SOFT WITH FROST:

THE WIND TURNS BACK. KEEP TO THE WANDS. TRUST NO SNOW YOU HAVE NOT SEEN ANOTHER CROSS.

interactions.label: FROZEN TARN
interactions.dialog: A TARN FROZEN TO THE BOTTOM, CLEAR AS GLASS. DOWN IN IT, A SCATTER OF COINS FROM EVERY WORLD YOU KNOW - AND SOME YOU DON'T. PEOPLE DROPPED THEM HERE FOR LUCK, ON THE WAY.

interactions.label: THE LAST CAIRN
interactions.dialog: THE HIGHEST POINT OF THE RIDGE, PRAYER FLAGS CRACKING IN THE WIND. TO THE SOUTH, THE HOARSPIRE, SMALL NOW. TO THE EAST THE RIDGE BENDS AND FALLS AWAY IN ONE LONG BOWL, AND AT THE BOTTOM OF IT, SOMETHING IS LIT.

interactions.label: CARVED STONE
interactions.dialog: A LANTERN CUT INTO THE STONE, AND UNDER IT AN ARROW POINTING STRAIGHT DOWN THE BOWL.
